minenow.settings.remote: This world runs on a server, which keeps its own settings. They can't be changed from here.
minenow.settings.villagersDefendTheVilla:
Armed villagers fight hostiles, man archer posts and gather when the bell rings.
Off: every villager panics and hides as in vanilla, and a bell only warns those within earshot.
minenow.settings.villagersEatMeals.toolt:
Villagers eat two meals a day from their pockets and home chest.
Off: they never eat, and no food is spent on meals.
minenow.settings.emeraldEconomy.tooltip:
Villagers keep emeralds, pay each other, and spend only what they can afford when they buy from you.
Off: emeralds are not counted. Villagers take what they need from each other for free, buy whatever you sell them, and keep none of the emeralds you pay. You still pay emeralds for what you buy.
minenow.settings.villagersFollowEmeralds:
Jobless villagers follow a player holding an emerald, so they can be led to a new home.
Off: they ignore it.
minenow.settings.villagerChestsLocked.to:
A villager's chests, barrels, armor stands and wall displays are locked for players.
Off: players can open and take from them, and taking is not theft.
minenow.settings.villagersPreferRoads.to:
Villagers prefer walking on paths and roads, and stroll along them when idle.
Off: they walk as in vanilla.
minenow.settings.villagersLevelThroughWo:
Villagers earn experience from their work, not only from trading with players. Levels decide how far a farmer's field reaches, how deep a miner digs and which recipes a craftsman knows.
Off: only trading levels them up, as in vanilla, so they progress much more slowly.
minenow.settings.villagersGetNames.toolt:
Every villager gets a name, and their births and deaths are announced.
Off: new villagers stay nameless as in vanilla. Names already given stay.
minenow.settings.travellingMerchants.too:
A village's export goods draw travelling merchants that buy them for new emeralds and sell goods the village can't make.
Off: none come.
minenow.settings.villagersSummonGolems.t:
Villagers summon iron golems as in vanilla.
Off: the golemsmith builds a village's golems.
minenow.settings.inkAndQuillRecipes.tool:
Players can craft the cartographer's ink and quill from a feather, an ink sac and a glass bottle, and a book and quill takes it in place of an ink sac and a feather.
Off: vanilla's book and quill recipe stays as it is.
minenow.settings.maxMerchantTours.toolti: How many village merchants may be on a tour at the same time. A touring merchant keeps the chunks around it loaded; one over the limit waits at home.
minenow.settings.profession.farmer.toolt:
Farmers tend the field beside their composter with a hoe, never trample farmland, and trade their crops with players and other villagers.
Off: farmers farm and trade as in vanilla, and take no part in villager trading. Their vanilla trades stay the same each time it is off.
minenow.settings.profession.fisherman.to:
Fishermen cast a rod at the water by their barrel, keep the catch in it, and trade with players and other villagers.
Off: fishermen work and trade as in vanilla, and take no part in villager trading. Their vanilla trades stay the same each time it is off.
minenow.settings.profession.shepherd.too:
Shepherds shear the sheep by their loom, spin wool into string, open fence gates, and trade with players and other villagers.
Off: shepherds work and trade as in vanilla, and take no part in villager trading. Their vanilla trades stay the same each time it is off.
minenow.settings.profession.butcher.tool:
Butchers keep a herd by their smoker, breed, cull and feed it, smoke meat, open fence gates, and trade with players and other villagers.
Off: butchers work and trade as in vanilla, and take no part in villager trading. Their vanilla trades stay the same each time it is off.
minenow.settings.profession.librarian.to:
Librarians make paper, books and enchanted books at their lectern, and trade them with players and other villagers.
Off: librarians bind no books and trade as in vanilla, and take no part in villager trading. Their vanilla trades stay the same each time it is off.
minenow.settings.profession.cleric.toolt:
Clerics brew potions at their brewing stand, sell them, heal hurt villagers and throw splash potions at enemies.
Off: clerics brew and heal nothing, panic like any villager, and trade as in vanilla, taking no part in villager trading. Their vanilla trades stay the same each time it is off.
minenow.settings.profession.mason.toolti:
Masons cut stone for sale, and pave dirt paths while a redstone signal reaches their stonecutter or a villager pays them to.
Off: masons pave nothing, take no paving orders and trade as in vanilla, taking no part in villager trading. Their vanilla trades stay the same each time it is off.
minenow.settings.profession.cartographer:
Cartographers draw a map of their village and trade it with players and other villagers.
Off: cartographers draw no map and trade as in vanilla, and take no part in villager trading. Their vanilla trades stay the same each time it is off.
minenow.settings.profession.toolsmith.to:
Toolsmiths craft stone, copper, iron and diamond tools, fishing rods and shears at their smithing table, and trade them with players and other villagers.
Off: toolsmiths craft nothing and trade as in vanilla, and take no part in villager trading. Their vanilla trades stay the same each time it is off.
minenow.settings.profession.fletcher.too:
Fletchers craft sticks, ladders, arrows, bows and wooden tools at their fletching table, practise at a target block, and trade them with players and other villagers.
Off: fletchers craft and practise nothing and trade as in vanilla, and take no part in villager trading. Their vanilla trades stay the same each time it is off.
minenow.settings.profession.armorer.tool:
Armorers craft armor and shields at their anvil, dress the armor stands beside it, and trade them with players and other villagers.
Off: armorers craft and dress nothing and trade as in vanilla, and take no part in villager trading. Stands they dressed stay locked as theirs, and their vanilla trades stay the same each time it is off.
Weaponsmiths craft swords at their grindstone, grind worn blades into one, hang their best swords on the wall, and trade them with players and other villagers.
Off: weaponsmiths craft, grind and hang nothing and trade as in vanilla, and take no part in villager trading. Swords already on the wall stay locked as theirs, and their vanilla trades stay the same each time it is off.
minenow.settings.profession.leatherworke:
Leatherworkers craft leather goods at their cauldron, bone-meal tall flowers for dye, dye armor, hang tanning racks and dress armor stands, and trade with players and other villagers.
Off: leatherworkers do none of it and trade as in vanilla, and take no part in villager trading. Racks and stands already up stay locked as theirs, and their vanilla trades stay the same each time it is off.
minenow.settings.profession.miner.toolti:
Miners dig a mine at their furnace minecart and sell what they dig.
Off: miners lose their job and keep their items, and no villager takes a furnace minecart as a job site.
minenow.settings.profession.forester.too:
Foresters fell the trees around their nursery and plant new ones.
Off: foresters lose their job and keep their items, and no villager takes a nursery as a job site.
minenow.settings.profession.smelter.tool:
Smelters smelt raw ore and burn logs into charcoal at their blast furnace, and trade with players and other villagers.
Off: a villager at a blast furnace is an armorer, and keeps its items.
minenow.settings.profession.golemsmith.t:
Golemsmiths mend iron golems and build new ones at their golem workshop.
Off: golemsmiths lose their job and keep their items, and no villager takes a golem workshop as a job site. A half-built golem stays where it stands. With villagersSummonGolems off too, a village gets no new golems.
minenow.settings.profession.merchant.too:
Merchants keep pack mules at their pack station and go on tours to other villages.
Off: merchants lose their job and keep their items, a tour in progress ends, their mules are let go and the cargo in their chests goes to the merchant, and no villager takes a pack station as a job site.
